applicability: Retained Curator-coherence generation evidence integrity and pre-canonical validation of newly published Curator generations; not historical assessment-channel consumption by the Reviewer.
conditions: Assessment evidence-bytes edges name the assessment’s own recorded destination directory, resolve within the task root, and are checked against the actual recorded digests.
The publisher writes the immutable generation and rechecks the source observation and recorded judgments before loading that exact generation’s integrity record.
The canonical authority replacement occurs only after that integrity read has returned successfully.
exclusions: Restoring the deleted comparison-bound historical assessment reader or availability/currentness channels to the current Reviewer.
Reconstructing evidence destinations from authored citation spelling or rewriting original recorded judgments.
Inferring that a corrupt historical assessment channel is still isolated and supplied through the removed channel-composition pipeline.
statement: Curator generation assessment evidence is validated at the publisher-recorded, task-confined destination, including admitted aliases, against the recorded digest instead of reconstructing a destination from citation spelling. The newly published immutable generation must pass its integrity read before canonical authority is replaced; rejection before that replacement preserves the prior authority.
